title: Vaccination Appointment Policy
content: Vaccination slots are booked separately from consultations and are released every Monday for the following two weeks. A parent or guardian must accompany any patient under twelve years of age for the whole visit. A vaccination appointment cannot be rescheduled inside 24 hours of the slot, because the vial is drawn from cold storage on the morning of the visit. The vaccination charge is listed separately from the consultation fee and is not eligible for the follow-up discount.
